biological_mechanism.gene_mutation: Mitochondrial Complex I deficiency / Environmental toxin model (Rotenone / MPTP mimic)
biological_mechanism.cellular_pathology: Impaired oxidative phosphorylation and electron transport chain failure leading to aberrant neuronal firing before terminal motor failure
biological_mechanism.lif_intervention: Altered membrane integration threshold and phase disruption in descending motor outputs
